title: [MTR4] STCP Bus Pack
description: Adds various buses to MTR4, with STCP's livery
body:
## STCP Bus Pack This pack features various buses with STCP's livery. As time passes, I'll expand this pack with newer models/new buses so stay tuned! All buses in this pack feature various features to improve the immersion and realism of these vehicles:
Click to expand - **Working sounds** - **Indicator lights** - **Front/Side/Rear displays** - *Realistic wheels* (Zhongtong N9 exclusive) - **Animated doors** (smooth animation on the Zhongtong N9, frame-by-frame animation on the N12) - **PBR textures** (requires shaders)
Below is a list of all buses included in this pack, as of **v0.1.0**.
Current buses (Click to expand) *Requires the Zhongtong Base Pack:* - **Zhongtong N9** - 9m midi bus ideal for small routes that go through narrow streets - **Zhongtong N12** - 12m standard bus, perfect for most urban routes
> If you have any suggestions for buses to add (keep in mind that they must have been used at least once by STCP) feel free to let me know through the discord server! ![Zhongtong N9 standing at a stop, opening its doors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DcJuzGaD/images/a1761b3c9f707f5b1cfceb0eb13bd1d1ee4cdea3.png) ## Requirements This bus pack requires **[Joban Client Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/jcm)** to provide the animations/features of the Zhongtong N9 and future models.\ Additionally, this pack also recommends installing the **Zhongtong Base Pack** if you're using the Zhongtong buses in this pack. (without the basepack these won't work) ## Retexturing this bus Would you like to retexture any of these buses for your own operator?
Check out the base packs under my profile or contact me (by joining my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/astMcchNdP)/sending me a DM from the MTR server) to be able to assist you! ## Support, Issues and Suggestions If you find any issues in this pack, have any suggestions for improvement or need help setting this up, feel free to join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/astMcchNdP)! I also post sneak peeks of my upcoming packs there :) > **Note:** This project is NOT affiliated with, and is not an official product of STCP ## Terms of Use
